description.value: Peking Restaurant is a long-standing Chinese restaurant on Hastings Street in Burnaby, serving a broad Cantonese-Canadian menu that spans ginger beef, chow mein, congee, hot pot, and fresh seafood across dozens of dishes. It operates as a full dine-in establishment with indoor seating and also offers online ordering for takeout. Cyclists riding the Hastings corridor between Burnaby and Vancouver will find a filling, familiar sit-down meal with a very large menu to choose from.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pekingrestaurantburnaby.com is live and fully functional, confirming an active Chinese restaurant at 5939 Hastings St, Burnaby with a detailed menu, online ordering system, and 42 reviews; the 'We are closed at the moment' notice is a real-time ordering-system status, not a permanent closure. Phone (604-299-2526) and address match OSM. The OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the website and postal address clearly place this in Burnaby — flagged as a concern. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere; the menu legend explicitly lists a 'vegetarian' marker and tofu is a standalone menu category, confirming vegetarian options; the online ordering feature confirms takeout availability.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the business address (5939 Hastings St, V5B 3X7) and website both place it in Burnaby — community tag should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Chinese restaurant with an active website, full menu, and online ordering; no evidence of closure or inaccessibility.
enrichment_extras.notes: The recurring 'We are closed at the moment. Ordering system is disabled.' banner is a real-time operational status tied to the ordering platform, not a permanent closure indicator.
